4509.title: Thread panel PR selection is transient
4509.rootCauseOneLine: The PR picker changes only component state and never writes a thread-to-PR link.
4509.proposedFix: Define manual-versus-branch PR precedence and unlink behavior, then add a persisted link mutation exposed through the panel and CLI.
4509.caveats: The mounted-panel test reproduces the missing save request; no live browser tab-switch run was needed.
